assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D dark fantasy game animation sprites, high detail realistic hand painted cutouts, anatomically sound. A PERFECT FOUR COLUMN by FOUR ROW GRID of sixteen separated full body poses on genuinely transparent background, no labels, no borders, no ground, no cast shadow, no additional floating items. All cells equal square with ample padding, exactly one figure per cell; all faces look to the RIGHT, pure SIDE VIEW, identical scale and outfit. Same Black adult male ranger as reference, teal hood and torn teal cape, dark brown leather armor, copper scarf, steel shoulder plates. Critical: all weapons firmly held in anatomically correct hands, never detached, and complete unclipped weapon in EACH pose. Row1 four distinct running cycle phases, opposite foot contact / passing / contact / passing. Row2 four jumping poses: crouched push-off, rising tucked knees, stretched apex, descending feet down. Row3 four attack phases with clear whole body torque: anticipation, accelerating strike, full extension impact, recovery. Row4: relaxed idle ready stance, hurt reaction leaning back, crouched landing, low forward dodge. Dramatic cape follow-through and readable silhouette, not pixel art. Weapon is ONE realistic slim steel sword with brass crossguard held firmly in right fist. During running kept low forward; during jump drawn close to body; attack row a forward sweeping sword cut. Preserve reference identity.
